description: She wears a warm cream full-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-and-brown embroidered borders decorate the neckline, bodice panels, sleeve cuffs, waist and long front skirt opening. Round brooches fasten the upper bodice straps. A decorated belt with a circular clasp and tassel secures the waist. A bronze-brown wrap with wide gold-toned patterned borders drapes loosely around the forearms and down both sides. Gold-colored earrings, a broad bracelet and small rings are visible. A modest lower opening shows a brown embroidered closed shoe and part of the lower leg. Opaque textured fabrics cover the bust, abdomen and pelvis; exact fibers are uncertain.
